category_id_note: annotation IDs are VisDrone 1-based; category table is 0-based
bus_synonym_policy: not provided; excluded from synonym evaluation and retention
operating_threshold_policy: reuse each model's frozen Experiment 1 validation threshold
negative_image_policy: all unique RefDrone test images are evaluated for every category prompt
gt_policy: Standard/synonym prompts and specificity Layer 1 use exhaustive VisDrone2019-DET evaluation GT for the same byte-identical images. Layers 2 and 3 use RefDrone attribute/referent GT. The already-frozen 50 images and prompts are unchanged.
layer3_prompt_form: lower-case short noun phrase normalized from the original RefDrone expression; articles, copulas, and sentence-final punctuation removed; class nouns canonicalized
